overview: The forty leaves are open at the hollow crown. The two lines are under your finger. Dick's hand is on the table beside the sheet, and it has not moved. You are reading, not mending.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Held the two lines under a finger and did not revise them.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Left his hand flat beside the leaf.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Kept the leaf open where the king sits on the ground

summary: Kept the leaf open where the king sits on the ground
